messages:
elaine: Quick thread to lock the perf/W protocol for the marketplace blurb. Partner asked for a single recommended SKU + one fallback. Need clear measurement rules.

sam: Proposal: use external PDU as primary power source, sample at 250ms. Warmup = 60s, steady-state window = next 90s. Report tokens/sec and tokens/sec/W normalized to seq=256. Batches: 1,8,32,128.

diego: Agreed. Add long-context check at seq=1024 for throughput regression. Also capture KV hit rate and batch distribution in telemetry.

elaine: Acceptance gate idea: best-config toks/sec/W >= 85% of our certified baseline => "Recommended". 70-85% => "Supported (reduced perf)" with note. <70% => do not list.

sam: I'll own the telemetry schema + small parser that consumes PDU CSV or IPMI fallback. Will include power_source and power_resolution_ms fields.

diego: I'll draft kernel-change matrix (3 knobs) with expected perf delta and risk level. Each change gets a microbench and an automated regression check.

ops-bot: Partner run scheduled on lab-3 (slot rp-5211240). Logs: https://ci.redwood/runtime/rp-5211240

sam: Run complete. Quick numbers: seq256 batch32 fp16 -> 460 toks/s, steady watts 220W => 2.09 toks/s/W. p50 12ms, p90 26ms. Raw telemetry: s3://partners-bench/rp-5211240/tel.json

diego: Please attach PR links when ready. We need both telemetry schema and patch matrix before we freeze the listing.

elaine: Thanks — aim to review artifacts Thurs 10am PT and finalize the marketplace blurb. :thumbsup:
